arms.self_update: Same P/E, own raw previous Q8/Q9 and source-labeled historical state; LLM answers directly, no halfway guidance.
arms.new_signal: Same P/E, no own survey history; LLM answers Q8/Q9. Program combines its raw probability bins with own previous raw bins.

probability_combination: final_bin=(1-alpha)*previous_bin+alpha*signal_bin; refit combined bins with pinned scorer, do not mix fitted means
point_combination: final_point=(1-alpha)*previous_point+alpha*signal_point; missing previous point makes only this secondary outcome unavailable

selection.aggregation: equal mean across month-by-repeat cells, no pooling months as independent people
selection.objective: mean of three candidate aggregate metrics divided by the corresponding development copy-previous aggregate metric; denominators bounded below at 0.001pp
selection.eligibility: at least 99% scorable candidate responses among otherwise common scorable development cases; all failure coverage reported; no current-answer-based resampling
selection.tie_break: lowest alpha among objectives within 1e-10 of minimum
selection.boundaries: alpha=0 and alpha=1 eligible; accepting copy-only is an allowed negative result
selection.freeze: save weight and hashes before running evaluation-month model calls; never retune on evaluation results

evaluation.primary: equal-weight same-cohort Q9 density-implied mean distributions; left inverse empirical CDF median/IQR
baselines: halfway from previous density mean toward past-only personal mean
evaluation.comparison: program minus self_update and copy_previous, paired within the same subjects and months; negative errors differences are improvement
evaluation.intervals: paired respondent resampling within each month, repeats held together; additional four-month cluster bootstrap sensitivity. Conditional diagnostic intervals, not population significance or nationwide forecast claims.
evaluation.success_gate: evaluation program center MAE, cross W1 and delta W1 all no larger than self_update and copy_previous, with >=99% scorable generated answers. Failure to pass is reported without changing the gate.

limitations: Retrospective current profiles and real previous answers; returners only, not nationwide or recursive B forecast.
Architecture comparison: LLM information differs and self_update may use longer history; no pure alpha causal effect claim.
Evaluation months are new to this tuning exercise, not guaranteed untouched by all earlier project work.
Model alias and training cutoff are not immutable; model knowledge leakage remains unexcluded.
Probability mixture can widen individual uncertainty; this must be reported separately from cross-person spread.
CE structural proxy and annual synthetic confidence are not observed respondent attributes; provenance and staleness reported.
